rule: The XI is built only from the two official top-10 lists: the six best-ranked batters and the five best-ranked bowlers, with two balance constraints - at least one wicketkeeper among the batters (is_wk in the playing-XI file in at least half of the player's matches) and at least one pace bowler and one spinner among the bowlers; if a constraint fails, the lowest-ranked pick is swapped for the best-ranked qualifying player. Batters are placed by their median batting position. It is a model-selected combination, not a team-balance optimiser: the data hold no all-rounder or fielding information.
